title: USG Input Reading
emits: evidence records (source_kind, authority, confidence, provenance, source_origin, world_relation, participation_role, design_authority_relation)

compatible_protocol.note: The partition fields and authority_resolution are not in protocol 0.12; they need a protocol patch when accepted.

owner_decision.summary: Contract accepted for development; becomes canonical after v0.3.5 closes C-01 to C-10 and the fixtures pass. Partition fields stay local until a second adapter exists.

goal: Convert an arbitrary source into the smallest verified, tool-neutral representation sufficient to continue the intended production process (CUR-2026-11-03-INPUT-READ-GOAL).
requirements_for_v0_3_5: R-ARPL-1 count by identity, never by row
R-ARPL-2 every input record is used or listed as a named exception, including records dropped by the reader's own filters
R-ARPL-3 names, tags and groups are evidence; a declared kind can contradict function
R-ARPL-7 check that every expected input is present before reporting; a missing input is a stop, not an omission
